audit_items.proof_trace: Both `borrow()` and `withdraw_as_coin()` accept `&ObligationOwnerCap` as a required parameter; Sui's runtime enforces the sender must own this non-shared, non-copy object. The cap's `obligation_id` is set immutably at construction to `object::id(&obligation)` and has no mutable accessor, so the cap can only ever operate on its corresponding obligation. Cross-market attempts abort at the `obligations.borrow_mut(obligation_id)` table lookup before reaching the explicit market-ID check.
